metadata.what: VRAM held while each GPU TTS engine ran its benchmark, whole card as nvidia-smi reports it
metadata.how: nvidia-smi memory.used sampled every 15 s during the run (2026-11-10), idle baseline 14-29 MiB included; Chatterbox on the RTX 4060 from the 2026-09-05 transcribed run
metadata.note: VITS on the GTX 1650 finished its whole run in about 15 s and was sampled once mid-run: 585 MiB is a lower bound. Kokoro PyTorch matches the 977 MiB measured 2026-09-24 (docs/hardware-budget.md).
